thread:
sam (Design): pushed a fresh compact autoscale panel. main asks: make burst meaning explicit, surface Max(with burst), and surface pool priority reorder without hiding it. figma: https://redwood.design/f/autoscale-v4 :mag:

anya (PM): quick Q - should 'burst' represent extra GPUs or total cap? billing likes explicitness.

lee (Frontend): propose label: 'Burst budget — extra temporary GPUs'. show a secondary inline line: 'Max (with burst): 10 GPUs'. hover reveals estimated cost delta.

sam (Design): copied two microcopy options into figma. prefer 'Burst budget extra GPUs available for short surges' (short + hint).

zara (A11y): accessibility: sliders need aria-valuetext that reads like 'Burst budget: 2 GPUs for 10 minutes'. pool reorder must be keyboard operable and announce changes via live region. don't rely on color to indicate preemptible pools.

mike (SRE): backend note: org-wide burst headroom exists. UI should show when requested burst exceeds headroom and provide 'Request quota' CTA. also surface approximate fallback latency cost: 'Fallback may add ~100-300ms'.

lee (Frontend): plan: chips under pool picker showing 'Primary > Failover' with drag handles and tiny icons for reserved/preemptible. keyboard reorder: arrow keys + space to pick up. will expose aria-grabbed and ARIA live messages.

sam (Design): microcopy fixes: change 'Fixed capacity' to 'Fixed pool size' when min==max, add hint 'To enable autoscaling, set max > min' with docs link. add muted line under pool order: 'Estimated cost + latency when using fallbacks'.

zara (A11y): prefer inline help toggles instead of ephemeral tooltips for keyboard and screenreader users. ensure focus-visible on SLO slider and chips. I'll audit contrast after prototype.

anya (PM): handoff checklist: finalize copy (sam/anya), implement keyboard reorder + aria (lee/zara), headroom handling + CTA (mike), show Max(with burst) (lee). i'll open tickets tonight unless objections. :+1:

ui-bot: design file uploaded by sam (Design): https://redwood.design/files/autoscale-v4.fig

lee (Frontend): starting on PR for chips pattern tomorrow. tagging accessibility tests.

sam (Design): thanks all. leaving final copy in figma and pinging when updated. :rocket:
